posts.name: Mrityunjay Chakraborty
posts.cooked:
Dear IITM,

I had taken System commands back in the previous terms of december then repeated the oppe in Jan term and the repeat end term option this term. So will my evaluation for my total score be done as per the latest grading doc or the one which was used in the term when I registered?

I am asking this because this term BPTA has only 0.1 weightage wehras in the previous terms BPTA had 0.2 weightage. This calculation difference can result in my Total grade being evaluated to either B if done according to this term or A if it’s done according to previous terms.

Please reply as soon as possible. I request your kind assistance on this matter.

With regards,

Mrityunjay Chakrabort

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
So, the grading will be done as per Jan term’s grading document. Only the score from ET and OPPE score will be taken from this term.
Note: The BPT score from previous term will be taken for grade evaluation even if you did BPTs this term they were used only for OPPE eligibility.

posts.name: Mrityunjay Chakraborty
posts.cooked: Thanks for your response. However if I am eligible for bonus will i receive any ?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Bonus marks from the previous term will be added, if any, but no bonus from this term.

posts.name: Mrityunjay Chakraborty
posts.cooked: Thanks for you response. Sorry to disturb on a weekend.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: You don’t have to be sorry. Wishing you a relaxing Sunday!
